prompt:
Create ONE new KFB Slop asset sheet, landscape1536x1024, exactly SIX UNIQUE expressive absurd-surreal CARTOON CLAYMATION INK BLOB MONSTERS in3columns x2rows, TRUE transparent PNG. Theme: ideological habits and compulsive certainty embodied by humble HyperNorm residents, tender dry satire of human behavior. Weird/offbeat visceral acting, not complex conceptual machinery. All independently usable alone.
INPUTS: Image1 ORIGINAL style reference for rich tactile rounded plasticine ink modeling, eyelids, body/accessory craftsmanship. Image2 ORIGINAL family goo morphology only, NOT its repetitive angry grin. Neither is an edit target. Create NEW characters, not donor costumes/roles. No generated-style-parent chain.
ACCEPTED GENTLE MATERIAL STEERING: Preserve thick soft modeled rounded stop-motion plasticine clay, fine tactile fingerprints, restrained satin reflections and soft upper-left illumination. Only a SMALL bias from plum toward charcoal-black ink. Deep purple remains a subtle undertone; no further aggressive blackening, flattened volume or material overhaul. No luminous white/lavender rim, fuzzy fibre weave on goo, coarse grit, chrome or glossy vinyl. Props retain beautiful coherent handmade cloth/brass/wood cues. No polished generic Pixar-human face formula. Keep all lips DARK body-colored ink, no pink lipstick.
ANATOMY: one complete continuous UPRIGHT FOOTLESS ink blob each, asymmetric soft drooping rounded splat lobes, ink hands growing from goo. Faces/bodies dominate; only small collars/accessory accents. No human torso, legs, shoes, full human uniform or severed bust. All visible eyes WHITE/IVORY sclera around RED iris with BLACK pupil, fully filled modeled dark lids. No glowing red eyeballs. Teeth arise INSIDE mouth from upper gum, never outside/below lower lip; closed mouth toothless.
COMPOSITION: Precise3x2 equal cells, six equally prominent LARGE catalogue characters. Similar perceived body scale upper/lower row; entire silhouette including props and all droplets comfortably fits owncell, about84% cellheight with at least24px transparent margin. All upright toward camera, isolated, no touching/overlap/shared props/interactions. Transparent background/gutters, no floor/scenelet/shadow-disc/text/watermark/grid-lines. Readable at96px. EXACTLY TWO female-read designs, cells2and5, subtle lashes/styling rather than human anatomy. Fresh silhouettes, mouth actions/gazes/poses; don't repeat six angry grins or last sheet's faces.
READING ORDER,top-left to bottom-right:
1. KENNZAHLEN-GLAUBE: Compact tall egg-shaped male-read ink blob, two very unequal soft crest nubs, tiny ivory office collar only. One hand holds a SINGLE small old brass mechanical tally counter with a plain blank dial; other hand proudly presses the counter button. Wide feverishly delighted eyes, brows arched in revelation, narrow tilted OPEN mouth with two uneven UPPER teeth. He believes a count has settled an argument. No graphs, numbers, text, labcoat or machinery body.
2. NOSTALGIE ALS GEWISSHEIT: Female-read broad pear-shaped ink splat with a small pinned ink curl and modest lashes, dusty blue lace COLLAR accent only. Clutches a SINGLE small old oval handmirror whose glass is dull sepia, NO portrait/face inside it. Eyes turned upward in wistful certainty, one brow gentle and other defensive; long asymmetric CLOSED fond smile with one corner drooping. Other ink hand fondly polishes mirror edge with a fingertip. She knows the past was better because she has stopped inspecting it. No full dress, hair wig, framed scene or text.
3. KONSENS ERZWINGEN: Wide flat-topped rounded male-read ink blob with three short floppy uneven crest lobes, one small faded coral bow tie. One hand grips a SINGLE tiny brass desk service bell, other hand slowly gives a reassuring THUMBS UP close to his body. Terribly strained broad CLOSED toothless smile, eyelids very uneven: one forced kindly wide eye, other sharp inspecting squint. The broad smile looks exhausting. No closed-eye grin, badges, voting slips, poster or second person.
4. REINHEIT ZWANGHAFT PRÜFEN: Tall thin wavering male-read ink blob with one drooping side crest, tiny faded moss apron FRONT PATCH leaving goo dominant. Holds a SINGLE very small white feather duster at chest height, other dark ink hand meticulously inspects his own dark fingertip. One eye enormous and the other narrowed anxiously, forehead folds of self-suspicion, tiny crooked OPEN breath-catching mouth with ONE upper tooth inside. The compulsive purity tester is himself a blob of ink. No spotless white full-body costume, soap bubbles, microscope, literal cross-eyed gag or dirt cloud.
5. DER MARKT WIRD ES RICHTEN: Female-read curvy asymmetrical upright crescent ink blob, tiny soft swept inkquiff and subtle lashes, muted mustard neck ribbon only. Holds ONE tiny old-fashioned brass balance scale with two clearly EMPTY shallow pans, simple thick readable geometry, no coins. Other ink hand open in a compact conjurer's flourish. Cool overconfident half-lidded eyes with white sclera, one amused lifted brow, skewed OPEN three-upper-tooth laugh. No witch hat, wand, extra floating props, symbols, graphs or human body.
6. SICHERHEIT ALS ROMANTISCHES IDEAL: Broad round male-read ink blob with low rippling crest and a soft small burgundy scarf. Both ink hands tenderly cradle ONE small closed brass padlock against his chest like a cherished keepsake. Half-lidded dreamy white eyes glance at it with utter devotion, brows steeply tender rather than angry, tiny CLOSED puckered almost-kiss mouth. Sweet but faintly worried reverence, upright whole body. No key, door, cage, giant lock, heart symbols or pink human lips.
The strongest emotion beat must read in the living ink facial/body acting. Satire with heart, vulnerable conviction, not grotesque randomly knotted features. No inherited top-right O-mouth or bottom-right tongue formulas. Few functional-looking tactile props, clean cutout sheet; original KFB clay ink identity throughout.
